description: Local overrides for fleet-management-operator. prConcurrentLimit/prHourlyLimit throttle Renovate so it doesn't open a batch of PRs at once — this repo's CI matrix is heavy and a burst saturates the account-wide Actions concurrency limit, starving other rknightion repos.

packageRules.description: OpenTelemetry Go modules release in lockstep — group across all update types so a bump is never a partial set.
Kubernetes client/apimachinery libs are co-versioned — bumping one without the others breaks the build.
Prometheus client libraries are co-versioned — group them into one PR.
